title: Souvenirs
description:
Примечания к обновлениюSoon, we'll implement a challenge mode, with new levels, new bonuses and weekly challenges !

Об игреExplore a house in search of Leonardo's memories.

Souvenirs is a merge like strategy game, created by a tiny independent French studio.
Merge objects in distorded containers and unlock the story of the painter Leonardo and his family.

You can use limited bonuses as well as a chance to continue the level by spending in-game currency which is unlocked by scoring and completing levels.FEATURES
- The Anvil makes the item in hand very heavy and allows it to reach the bottom of the playing area (if you are lucky!)

- The Slingshot allows you to remove a specific object by targeting it.

- The Upgrade allows the object in hand to evolve into its next form.
